context: Test-only monkeypatch of the timeouts module signal attributes with restoration handled by pytest; retain fallback test and exact two-signal ordering.
description: The production fallback for hosts without os.killpg is correct. The positive-branch test injects os.killpg on Windows but then references absent signal.SIGKILL. Inject deterministic SIGTERM/SIGKILL sentinels for the test and assert both calls, without changing timeout production logic.

preserves.behavior: POSIX production uses SIGTERM then SIGKILL on the process group.
Windows production falls back to proc.kill when os.killpg is unavailable.

verifications.expected: fails on the unfixed Windows tree with missing SIGKILL; exit 0 after repair

work_units.evidence: uv run -- python missing-SIGKILL harness: EXPECTED_BASELINE_FAILURE AttributeError
Injected opaque SIGTERM/SIGKILL sentinels with raising=False; missing-SIGKILL harness passes
work_units.summary: Inject portable signal sentinels in the positive branch test

work_units.evidence: uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 tests/uat/test_timeouts.py -q: 8 passed; git status shows only tests/uat/test_timeouts.py
work_units.summary: Run timeout tests and verify production module is unchanged
